name: Abgar V
role: King of Osroene and 1st Christian king
contribution: An Assyrian, Aramean or Armenian King of Osroene with his capital at Edessa and described as "king of the Arabs".
legacy: According to a popular Christian tradition attested as early as Eusebius and also found in the Doctrine of Addai, this person wrote a letter to Jesus asking him to visit Edessa and heal him.

checks.lead: Abgar V (c. 1st century BC – c. AD 50), called Ukkāmā (meaning "the Black" in Syriac and other dialects of Aramaic), was an Assyrian, Aramean or Armenian King of Osroene with his capital at Edessa and described as  "king of the Arabs".
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
